doc.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000

title: Hamilton's alumni culture, Gold Group and Joe Anderson
summary: Alumni are the college's strength; he praises Joe Anderson's Gold Group and the senior gift.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: That’s the whole ball game. And the people who run it are smart enough to know that so they cater to the alumni. And that’s the difference. Let’s hope it will always be thus.
I hope so. It seems to be continuing, if you attend reunion weekend you get that feeling.

Well I think that they’ve done such a wonderful job — Joe Anderson, who is no longer here, caused a lot of problems but he did a lot of great things too. I think the birth of the Gold Group was just a genius idea. And that’s been copied now by a lot of colleges that duplicated it. But that was his idea originally and it has helped so much to bring new alumni into the fold here. And the senior gift every year. The people care about the college. That’s the difference.
